name: Bull-nettle
desc: Bull-nettle (Cnidoscolus stimulosus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 48 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Cnidoscolus stimulosus, the bull nettle, spurge nettle, stinging nettle, tread-softly or finger rot, is a perennial herb covered with stinging hairs, native to southeastern North America.
